//README: Deliberate non-coverage of a BEHAVIORAL name — one a user can reach that no suite asserts. Each key is a global name; each value is the reason it needs no direct suite. Internal helpers are NOT listed here: the gate never fails on them, so waiving them would be noise. A behavioral name belongs here only when a direct suite would add no protection a feature-level suite or the golden compare does not already give — say so, specifically. Regenerate tests/coverage-inventory.md after editing (node tools/build-coverage-inventory.js). Keys starting with // are notes, not waivers (a real global can start with _, so _ is not a safe note marker).
//status: 3.10.5 wires the gate on; 3.10.10 makes coverage EXECUTION-based (a name counts only when a suite actually runs its function under V8, not when the suite's text merely mentions it). The re-audit against execution data dropped this list from 26 to 23: toggleCurrentGenerationFilter, togglePastePanel and disarmPresetButton turned out to be genuinely executed by a node suite (preview-search / paste + stale-results / presets respectively), so they are covered now, not waived. The 23 that remain are DOM-state, keyboard, cross-window, or download/anchor plumbing whose function body a node/vm sandbox never actually enters — no suite executes them, and the execution report agrees (each shows 'waived', i.e. uncovered-with-a-reason). Where each has a computed core, that core is pinned by a named suite or the golden compare; what is left — a class toggle, an aria attribute, an anchor click, a window handoff — belongs to the Playwright E2E suite (tests/e2e/), now BUILT in 3.10 (7 specs across the four pages plus xlsx column-mapping, PWA offline and an axe a11y gate), which also retired the outstanding 3.9 browser smoke-test debt. NOTE: that E2E suite runs OUTSIDE this V8-instrumented node coverage run, so these 23 names still show uncovered HERE and stay waived-with-reason. Its specs are aws/azure/gcp/multicloud happy paths, xlsx column-mapping, PWA offline and an axe a11y gate — so the browser-layer residual is VERIFIED there only for the paths those specs actually drive (provider/exclude/recommendation-type toggles, file upload, the CSV menu, xlsx mapping, offline). The portfolio, scenario-comparison and preset-interaction paths (onPortfolioMessage, openAppPortfolio, switchPortfolioTab, sortPortfolioApps, togglePortfolioFilter, exportPortfolioWorkbook, downloadAppCsv, compareScenarios, downloadScenarioComparison, onPresetNameKeydown, importPresets, handlePresetImportFile) have NO E2E spec yet, so their browser residual is an ACCEPTED-BUT-UNVERIFIED risk, not verified — to be closed when those specs land (3.11). In every case the computed CORE each name sits on IS covered today by the named node suite or golden compare its reason cites; what stays unverified in the browser is only the DOM/anchor/cross-window plumbing around that core.
